dedup.note: Checked against the 30-day history_digest. Dropped as repeats or follow-ups: (1) NVIDIA 'Into the Omniverse' agents-to-simulation post. It is the same running story as the NVIDIA tech blog 'How to Use AI Agents to Prepare 3D Scenes for Simulation' (09-18) and reports no new release. (2) Builder.io 'How to use WebMCP'. It is a tutorial on the WebMCP story (Vercel mcp-handler 09-19), so it is a follow-up with no new release. (3) Fast Company 'Big Tech is cutewashing its AI agents'. It is the same mascot-branding thread as 'With Meta's Muse Charm, AI enters its kawaii era' (09-27) and 'OpenAI's new dots agents come with a crew of friendly mascots' (09-30), and it is commentary only. (4) Vercel FLUX 3 Image on AI Gateway. It is the same release as the-decoder's Flux 3 launch (10-03). Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Lite on AI Gateway is in the same c10 content-hub cluster and is a gateway listing, not design news. (5) The Figma Blog post on the Figma agent and design system upkeep. It is a guidance post on the same Figma agent covered on 10-07 ('3 ways product designers use the Figma agent') and has no new release. Kept as an alternate. Also dropped for other reasons: the DEV 'Nano Banana 2.1' post was already rejected as near-advertorial on 10-08 (it promotes the author's ReelDance). Google Playground (80 Level) is reserved for games. Fanta's AI Halloween ad is advertising critique that fits marketing better. Engineering.com 'AI in PLM' is organizational-readiness analysis. MindStudio's Kandinsky 6 and Tencent Prism posts are SEO-style model explainers. The UX Collective essays (incidents, gamification) and the DEV 'Five UI patterns' post are evergreen and lower-ranked. The final 5 come from Engineering.com, Creative Bloq x2, DEV Community and Microsoft Design (YouTube): 4 distinct outlets, and the cap of 2 per outlet is respected. Categories: cad, render, workflow, figma, social, one each, so every card keeps its category accent.

items.rationale: New release: Graphisoft's 2026 Archicad portfolio adds MCP connectivity, AI Visualizer updates, MEP Designer expansion and a new Archicad Max tier, which affects architects' BIM-plus-AI workflow right away.
items.excerpt: The 2026 portfolio adds MCP connectivity, AI Visualizer updates, MEP Designer expansion and a new Archicad Max subscription.

items.rationale: A hands-on review of KeyShot 2026's AI Shots, which puts generative AI inside product rendering, tells product designers whether the new AI tools are worth using.
items.excerpt: Creative Bloq reviews KeyShot 2026, whose AI Shots feature brings generative AI into the heart of the product-rendering workflow alongside its fast, easy 3D rendering.

items.rationale: A developer used AI to rebuild a free suite of Creative Cloud-style apps. It shows how cheap AI-built creative software has become and what that means for designers' tool choices and for Adobe.
items.excerpt: A developer used AI to rebuild a suite of Adobe Creative Cloud-style apps and released it for free, raising questions about what AI-built creative software means for designers and Adobe.

items.rationale: The post breaks down the 71 lines of Anthropic's frontend-design skill, shows how to install it, and builds the same landing page with and without it, so designers can see what the skill changes and install it today.
items.excerpt: Anthropic's frontend-design skill for Claude Code: what its 71 lines tell Claude, how to install it, and a landing page built with and without it on the same brief.

items.rationale: Microsoft Design's behind-the-scenes look at the new Copilot visual identity is a primary-source case study in branding an AI agent product.
items.excerpt: Your apps, tools, and context come together in our new Copilot identity, inspired by work and designed for it.
